mapper.sql: SELECT a.*, COALESCE(c.name, s.name) AS partner_name, ac.name AS account_name, v.voucher_no FROM fin_advance a LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON a.kind = 'RECEIPT' AND c.id = a.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON a.kind = 'PAYMENT' AND s.id = a.partner_id LEFT JOIN fin_account ac ON ac.id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = a.voucher_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, b.bill_no, v.voucher_no, st.settle_no FROM fin_advance_apply p JOIN fin_bill b ON b.id = p.bill_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = p.voucher_id LEFT JOIN fin_settlement st ON st.id = p.settlement_id WHERE p.advance_id = #{advanceId} ORDER BY p.id
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_advance SET used_amount = used_amount + #{amount}, used_fc = used_fc + #{fc}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND used_amount + #{amount} <= amount AND used_amount + #{amount} >= 0 AND used_fc + #{fc} <= amount_fc
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.advance_no, a.kind, a.partner_id, a.advance_date, a.amount, a.used_amount, a.currency, a.exchange_rate, a.amount_fc, a.used_fc, a.remark FROM fin_advance a WHERE a.kind = #{kind} AND a.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND a.used_fc < a.amount_fc ORDER BY a.advance_date, a.id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - used_amount), 0) FROM fin_advance WHERE kind = #{kind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId}
